findings.title: The AC1 test reads a plain copy of the assets, not what norn init writes
findings.detail:
TEMPLATES_ROOT is a cpSync of the assets (line 48-49), so the test never runs init's withTestCommand rewrite. The rewritten init output is covered only by the e2e assertion in test/e2e/slice-workflow.test.ts, which was not run locally. Init copies the assets byte for byte apart from the `check: bun test` line, so the risk is low.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optional: validate the files that init writes through the cli harness, or rely on the e2e tier in CI.
